props.text: Categorical bars using the same native chart chrome, toolbar treatment, and dark dashboard styling as Histogram.
Hover a bar to inspect category, series, and value.
Direct labels and values rendered as a compact vertical bar chart.
Frame data aggregated by category with sales and cost side-by-side.
Horizontal orientation for longer category names.
Many categories stay readable by dropping crowded value labels first.

dirty.note: DragonGUI applies coarse dirty flags immediately; this history records the recent command reasons that triggered them.
